newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ weekly movement off to 4.054 million gallons.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ weekly movement off to 4.054 million gallons.

text.p: The Florida Citrus Processors Association said frozen concentrated orange juice movement into trade channels for the week ended September 7 was 4,053,569 gallons compared with 4,979,491 gallons last week.
Imports were 118,696 gallons compared with 115,916 gallons the previous week, and domestic receipts totaled 20,931 gallons versus 21,573 gallons a week ago.
Retail movement was 976,220 gallons compared with 930,457 gallons last year, while bulk movement was 2,562,261 gallons versus 3,850,148 gallons last year.
Current season cumulative movement was 211,575,771 versus 208,791,095 a year ago.
Inventory was 85,468,256 versus 94,551,601 gallons last year.
The final total pack for the season is 202,353,371 gallons compared with 216,502,392 gallons a year ago.
